_readme: Spoken alert lines for ED Outrider. Each alert below has lists of versions per personality;
the page picks one at random from every personality ticked in the alerts dialog, and from the
<personality>_profane lists too when 'with profanity' is ticked. Edit freely: the page picks up
changes without a restart, and a mistake is reported in the dialog while the last good copy is used.
{placeholders} are filled in: each alert's 'when' says which it has, and {name} (one of the names you asked to be called, picked at random), {cmdr} (your commander
name), {ship} (your ship's name) and {here} (the current system) work in every line.
Add a personality: a new entry under 'styles', then lists of that name (and <name>_profane) under
any alerts. An alert with no lines for the personalities ticked uses the plain wording.
